name: Fanatical Shriever
subtitle: citrus? I HATE CITRUS!
rules: TACTICAL -- COST – Play this only not during a battle. You may pick an item. -- When this card enters play, if you picked an item as part of its cost, destroy that item. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – When this card enters play you may pick a location. If you do, inflict 2 damage to that card.
flavor: Didn't you know dragons are allergic to lemon parties?
notes: Card prints 'Play this only not during a battle'; catalog has 'Deploy this only not during a battle' under EXTRA COST. Six threshold icons in the last paragraph (zoomed).

name: Surreptitious Larceny
subtitle: just ignore the menacing robot army
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- COST – Pick a player. This turn, that player may not play cards using FLIP UP. EFFECT – Look at the top card of any deck. -- OPTION 2 -- COST – Pick a character. EFFECT – This turn, that character gains COVERT. Draw a card. -- OPTION 3 -- COST – Pick a "gear" card. Pick a character. EFFECT – Attach the "gear" card to the character. This turn, the "gear" card loses all abilities.

name: Battle-Ready Back-Breaker
subtitle: a bulging brute
rules: When this card enters play you may pick a character. If you do, deplete that character.

name: B.A.S.E. Jump
subtitle: Geronimo!
rules: COST – Pick a location. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character, where X is the location's structure. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R]
flavor: You do not need a parachute to B.A.S.E. Jump. You only need a parachute to B.A.S.E. Jump twice.

name: Murderous Kleptomaniac
subtitle: steals anything he can, even life
rules: COVERT -- If this card is put into a discard pile from play, you may pick a character, item, or location. If you do, remove that card from the game. -- KLEPT – [D][D][D][D][D][D][D][D][D][D] -- COST – Pay 4. Pick a character or item. EFFECT – Take control of that card.
flavor: Some Clockman criminals are licensed professionals. Others are less... legitimate.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is put into a discard pile from play'; catalog has 'When'. Ten threshold icons in KLEPT (zoomed).
